text: ＊の　こうかで　＊しか　わざを　だせない！

patterns.name: 〜しか〜ない
patterns.span: ＊しか　わざを　だせない
patterns.explanation: しか must go with a no-style ending and means 'nothing but'. ＊しか　だせない = 'can only use ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a noun can give the reason something happens. ＊の　こうかで = 'because of ＊'s effect'.
